name: Sideway mobile customer experience
review_scope: Three approved new stills before three I2V takes; related stills share identity reference. Single-take subjective evidence, no general model superiority claim.

runs.review: Superseded after user observed gaze missing the phone during interaction. Original sampled review missed the temporal eye-line defect; gaze stability is not approved.
runs.review_method: Agent review of chronological full frames plus12/16 enlarged face or hand samples. Full decode. Native story transcribed locally; transcript alone does not prove lip sync.

runs.review: Original speech felt scripted to the user and omitted an explicit spoken app name. Regenerating with conversational phrasing and Sideway named in context.

Pre-animation source inspection, chronological portrait frames, 24 enlarged gaze frames for phone and 16 speaking face frames, local transcript and full decode. Subjective, sampled review.
runs.review: Corrected chin/phone geometry creates clearer binocular screen fixation. Early short taps then reading. Later longer blink and head lift at ~3.3–4.6s excluded: opening uses 0–3s; return uses 1–3s at 0.5x, a quiet reading stretch. Exact one-tap choreography not achieved.

runs.review: Plain personal speech and Sideway explicitly named; exact requested wording transcribed. Stable interviewer-directed eyes and relaxed brows. First 3s retained on camera; second thought is voiceover over closed-mouth arrival.

Forward-aligned shoulders/head, downward coffee gaze, no sideways street look or lens contact. Natural elbow support and stable handle grip. Small cup lift/settle and slight parted lips early despite requested closed lips; reads as a quiet breath near hot coffee, not sustained speech or a drinking gesture. No obvious hand/device distortion in sampled frames.
runs.review_method: Approved corrected still before I2V; 24 chronological enlarged face/shoulder/cup samples plus portrait frames and full decode. Subjective sampled review.
